constructionOrder: for i=0..10 interpolate left boundary and right boundary independently at i/10
original.prohibition: Do not interpolate center, localScale and buttonCount independently and multiply them at each section; when width changes that creates a different curved edge from the original boundary-first strip.

productInput.negativeZeroSvBoundary: When an endpoint cannot be represented, each visible section is reprojected at a finite clipped curve, but width still interpolates complete left/right boundary contributions rather than multiplying independently interpolated factors.
